import warnings, time; warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
y=dA_dt
def fit(f,n,tries=6,seed=0):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(seed);best=None
    for i in range(tries):
        p0=np.r_[1.46,0.406,rng.uniform(0.2,3,n)]
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p:np.nan_to_num(p[0]*A*np.log(1+abs(p[1])*t)+f(p[2:])-y,nan=1e3,posinf=1e3,neginf=-1e3),p0,max_nfev=150)
            if best is None or r.cost<best.cost:best=r
        except Exception as e: pass
    return '%.2e'%(2*best.cost/len(y)/np.var(y)),np.round(best.x,4)
H=lambda p,q:A**q/(abs(p)+A**q)
F={
'tanh':lambda p:-p[0]+p[1]*np.tanh(p[2]*A-p[3])+p[4]*A,
'atan':lambda p:-p[0]+p[1]*np.arctan(p[2]*A-p[3])+p[4]*A,
'logistic':lambda p:-p[0]+p[1]/(1+p[2]*np.exp(-p[3]*A))+p[4]*A,
'hill2+exp':lambda p:-p[0]*np.exp(-p[2]*A)+p[1]*H(p[3],2)+p[4]*A,

'hill+c+sqrt':lambda p:-p[0]+p[1]*H(p[2],p[3])+p[4]*np.sqrt(A),
'hill+c+log':lambda p:-p[0]+p[1]*H(p[2],p[3])+p[4]*np.log(1+p[5]*A),
'hill+MM':lambda p:-p[0]+p[1]*H(p[2],p[3])+p[4]*A/(1+p[5]*A),
'hill+c/(1+A)':lambda p:-p[0]/(1+p[5]*A)+p[1]*H(p[2],p[3])+p[4]*A,
'hill+sin':lambda p:p[0]*np.sin(p[5]*A+p[4])+p[1]*H(p[2],p[3]),
'hill-kA-c, exp':lambda p:-p[0]+p[1]*H(p[2],p[3])+p[4]*A*np.exp(-p[5]*A),
'inhib':lambda p:-p[0]+p[1]*A**p[5]/(p[2]+A+p[3]*A*A)+p[4]*A,
'hill2-kA^n':lambda p:-p[0]+p[1]*H(p[2],2)+p[4]*A**p[3],
}
